portals.title: Import from portals
portals.subtitle: Bring the listings you already publish on Mercado Libre, Urbania or Adondevivir into your catalog and keep them up to date.
portals.ownDataNotice: We only import your own agency's data, through official channels: your Mercado Libre account (with your authorization) and the files or feeds you export from your CRM, your website or the portal's panel. We never copy portal web pages.
portals.onlyAdmins: This section is for real estate agency admins.

ml.title: Mercado Libre Real Estate
ml.description: Connect your seller account and bring your active real estate listings with photos, location and features. The connection uses Mercado Libre's official API.
ml.notAvailable: The Mercado Libre integration is not enabled on the platform yet. Ask the administrator to configure the Mercado Libre app.
ml.disconnectBody: We'll stop syncing your listings. Listings already imported stay in your catalog.
ml.connectedToast: Mercado Libre connected. You can import your listings now.

feeds.title: Feeds from your CRM or website (XML / JSON / CSV)
feeds.description: If your real estate CRM or website publishes a link with your listings (the same one you use to send listings to Urbania or Adondevivir), add it here and we'll read it every day.
feeds.dialogHelp: Paste the link of the file your CRM or website exports. We'll analyze it and show how each field maps before saving.
feeds.name: Name
feeds.portal: Portal where you publish these listings
feeds.urlHelp: Must be a public link (http/https) to an XML, JSON or CSV file with your own listings.
feeds.deactivateMissing: When a listing disappears from the feed, deactivate it in the catalog (it is not deleted).
feeds.deleteBody: We'll stop reading it. Listings already imported stay in your catalog.

file.title: Exported file (Excel, CSV, XML or JSON)
file.description: Upload the file you export from your CRM or the portal's panel, or fill in our template. Uploading a file from the same origin again updates listings instead of duplicating them.
file.origin: Where does this file come from?
file.originHelp: Used to recognise listings when you import a file from the same origin again.
file.deactivateMissing: The file has all my listings: deactivate the ones from this origin that are no longer in it.
file.hint: XLSX, XLS, CSV, XML or JSON · up to 15 MB and 2000 listings.
file.tooBig: The file is too large (max 15 MB).
file.unsupported: Unsupported format. Use XLSX, XLS, CSV, XML or JSON.

mapping.intro: {count} listings found with {fields} different fields. Check where each field goes.
mapping.caption: Mapping of file fields to catalog fields
mapping.needId: Map a field to “Listing code”: that's how we recognise each listing on re-import.

preview.summary: {total} listings: {creates} new, {updates} to update, {errors} with errors.
preview.missing: {count} previously imported listings are no longer present and will be deactivated.
preview.foreign: {count} listings are priced in another currency (e.g. US$): they are saved with their own currency.
preview.withoutId: {count} records have no code and won't be imported.
preview.caption: Import preview
preview.name: Title

runs.title: Import history
runs.deactivationSkipped: nothing was deactivated because the source had no valid listings
runs.toast: Import done: {created} new, {updated} updated, {deactivated} deactivated, {failed} failed.

apiErrors.busy: An import from this source is already running. Wait for it to finish.
apiErrors.industry: Available for real estate agencies only.
apiErrors.mapping_external_id: Map a field to “Listing code” before continuing.
apiErrors.not_configured: The Mercado Libre app is not configured on the platform.
apiErrors.reconnect: The Mercado Libre authorization expired or was revoked. Connect your account again.
apiErrors.timeout: Mercado Libre didn't answer in time. Try again in a few minutes.
apiErrors.feed_format: The file is not valid XML, JSON or CSV.
apiErrors.feed_no_items: We found no listings in the file.
apiErrors.fetch_protocol: The URL must start with http:// or https://.
apiErrors.fetch_private: The URL points to a private address; use a public link.
apiErrors.fetch_dns: The URL's domain was not found.
apiErrors.fetch_too_large: The feed file is too large (max 15 MB).
apiErrors.fetch_redirects: The URL redirects too many times.
apiErrors.fetch_status: The feed server answered with an error. Check that the link is correct and public.
apiErrors.fetch_timeout: The feed server took too long to answer.
apiErrors.name: Enter a name.
apiErrors.label: Choose the file's origin.
apiErrors.too_many_feeds: You reached the maximum of 20 feeds.
apiErrors.ml_denied: You cancelled the authorization on Mercado Libre.
apiErrors.ml_state_malformed: Mercado Libre's response is not valid. Try connecting again.
apiErrors.ml_state_signature: Mercado Libre's response is not valid. Try connecting again.
apiErrors.ml_state_expired: The connection took too long. Try again.
apiErrors.ml_no_code: Mercado Libre didn't return an authorization code.
apiErrors.ml_session: Sign in with the same user who started the connection.
apiErrors.ml_forbidden: You need to be an admin of this agency.
apiErrors.ml_mismatch: The Mercado Libre account doesn't match the authorized one.
apiErrors.ml_exchange_failed: Mercado Libre rejected the authorization. Check the app settings and try again.
apiErrors.ml_not_configured: The Mercado Libre app is not configured on the platform.

admin.title: Mercado Libre (real estate import)
admin.subtitle: Mercado Libre app agencies use to connect their account and import their listings. Create the app in the DevCenter and paste its credentials here.
admin.redirectHelp: Register it exactly like this in the Mercado Libre app.
admin.mock: Development mode: calls go to a local test server.
admin.removeConfirm: Remove the Mercado Libre credentials? Agencies won't be able to import until you configure new ones.
